mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both PAYEMS and INDPRO decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past quarter indicates strong demand conditions, which typically support positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS has increased over the prior quarter, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production level below 105.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 105.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0), a decline in monthly employment (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions, which typically precede negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0 and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
